summary: DRA_DIRECTIONAL_VOLUME_PARTICIPATION_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed H1 corpus, primary prior, frozen declarative runner, unchanged DRA V1 parent parity, directionally weighted volume accounting and equal-capital assumptions passed. Primary 1.0 improved Design total PnL from 90.77797326 to 105.36030037 USDT, mainly by reducing terminal unrealized loss, but failed historical Validation: total PnL fell from 86.20298186 to 86.06498471, realized PnL fell from 89.41118307 to 86.06498471, drawdown rose from 7.121498% to 11.105036%, and median/P90 holding rose from 182.5/1418.3h to 193.5/2648.6h. Annual total-PnL breadth was only 2/5 and 95.500864% of positive annual uplift came from 2022. The 0.8 neighbor lost Validation PnL and lacked four interventions; the 1.2 neighbor lost heavily with worse drawdown. The exact family is closed without selecting a neighbor, changing candle direction, tuning, candidate creation or OOS access.
